medication_series: Prednisone acetate: 8, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.5, 1, NaN, NaN, NaN, NaN, NaN
clinical_events: Postoperative day 7: Abdominal ultrasound showed patent blood flow in the liver graft without obvious bile duct dilatation.
Postoperative day 14: Jaundice decreased and liver function markers continued to improve.
Postoperative day 30: The cyclosporine dose was adjusted according to drug concentrations after outpatient review.
Postoperative day 90: Infection screening showed no definite abnormalities.
Postoperative day 180: Growth and development remained stable; corticosteroids were gradually tapered toward discontinuation as planned.
Postoperative day 365: Annual ultrasound showed no vascular or biliary complications.
Postoperative day 540: A transient increase in aminotransferases gradually subsided on repeat testing.
Postoperative day 730: Liver and kidney function remained stable at the two-year follow-up; the immunosuppression regimen was maintained.
Postoperative day 1095: Repeat liver and kidney function tests remained stable, with no evidence of a new infection.
Postoperative day 1825: The five-year follow-up assessment was completed; scheduled monitoring of liver function and drug concentrations continued.
